question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Impede
solution:
The correct answer is option 4), i.e., 'Hinder.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Impede
 to make it more difficult for something to happen or more difficult for someone to do something. (बाधा डालना)
 
 
 

 
 

 
 
• 
 
​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Intend
 to have as a plan or purpose. (एक योजना या उद्देश्य के रूप में होना)
 
 

 Prompt
 to make something happen. (कुछ कर दिखाना; शीघ्र)
 
 

 Respite
 a useful delay before something unpleasant happens. (कुछ अप्रिय होने से पहले एक उपयोगी विलंब)
 
 

 Hinder
 to limit the ability of someone to do something, or to limit the development of something. (बाधा डालना)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• Clearly, the word 'Hinder' is closest in meaning to the given word 'Impede.'
 
• Therefore, the correct synonym of the given word is option 4.
